hooks.name: WhyGuard PreToolUse Guard
hooks.description: Generated by `whyguard init`. Before any file write, checks whether the edit removes historically protected behavior. On a block it returns a permissionDecision of 'ask' so Kiro prompts you to confirm — an agent can ignore a plain exit 2, but cannot bypass the IDE's own prompt.

hooks.name: WhyGuard Stop Verification
hooks.description: Generated by `whyguard init`. After the agent finishes, re-checks the checkout for protected behavior that was removed anyway. Inspects the result instead of asking permission, so it still reports what slipped through.
